# 2 Baruch Chapter 72 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "Now hear about the bright lightning that came at the end, after the black waters."

**2** "Here is what it means. After all the signs I have spoken about have taken place, when the nations are in turmoil and the time of my Messiah has arrived,"

**3** "he will gather all the nations — sparing some of them and slaying others."

**4** "These are the ones who will be spared: every nation that has not known my people, that has not oppressed Israel, and that has not trampled on the seed of Jacob."

**5** "This is because some among the nations have submitted to your people."

**6** "But all those who have ruled over you or mistreated you will be handed over to the sword."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
